feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 3 August 2026 5:32am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Occasional strong wind at first.


##Wind)##

E or NE 4 or 5, occasionally 6 in the north at first, decreasing 3 or 4 in the afternoon, veering E or SE 4 or 5 overnight.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate, becoming smooth or slight later.


##Weather)##

Occasional rain, becoming more widespread and perhaps thundery later.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain especially later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 19°C
##Sea Temperature##

16°C

##Warnings)##

Nil.


##Wind)##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather)##

Rain at first, possibly heavy in places, soon clearing to isolated showers.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or showers.

16°C
